scientific_limitations: General smooth complex projective complete-intersection surfaces only.
The ED degree is the generic projective value; special coordinates may lower it.
The optimization fixes codimension and the sum of defining degrees.
The balancing proof is surface-specific and is not asserted in higher dimensions.
title: Sharp ED-degree range for complete-intersection surfaces at fixed adjunction level
